extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
extraction.description: A dataset of 246,285 texture images across 56 texture classes generated using text-to-image models with a three-stage refinement process to ensure quality, diversity, and representativeness.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak, Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were generated using Stable Diffusion model pipelines with texture-specific prompts, followed by a three-stage refinement process (frequency filtering, patch variance filtering, CLIP score filtering) to remove object-like images, homogeneous images, and ensure prompt alignment.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Generated from text prompts using Stable Diffusion model, with prompts constructed by combining descriptors from categories including texture, artistic style, spatial arrangement, color enhancer, and color.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images flagged as NSFW by the safety filter were excluded from the dataset; no explicit content was found, but they were removed for ethical reasons.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Three-stage refinement: frequency filtering to remove object-like images (retain top 80% by high-frequency content), patch variance filtering to eliminate homogeneous images (remove bottom 20% by patch variance), and CLIP score filtering to ensure prompt alignment (remove bottom 20% by CLIP score).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (labels) are based on texture classes derived from prompts; each image is associated with a texture class from the 56 classes defined by the prompt descriptors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: CLIP scores were used to measure alignment between images and prompts; human evaluation confirmed CLIP scores effectively represent human-assigned representativeness scores.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: 9 participants were recruited for human evaluation; demographics not specified.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: CLIP model for scoring, Fourier transforms for frequency analysis, patch variance calculations.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Dataset available for download at Zenodo; versioning, updating timeframe, maintainers, and deprecation policies not specified.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Dataset enables research on texture bias in machine learning models, uncovering associations between textures and objects that can affect model accuracy and trustworthiness.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: NSFW safety filter flagged up to 60% of initial generated images, with textures like 'paisley' triggering high flagging rates; flagged images were excluded, potentially introducing bias in texture representation.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Structured textures like grid and polka-dotted had lower Inception and FID scores; NSFW filtering may limit diversity; dataset may not generalize to all texture types.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, testing, and validation for texture-based tasks such as measuring texture bias, texture-object association analysis, and model interpretability studies.
